name: feature-request
description: Evidence-backed feature request intake, triage, delivery tracking, and project operations.

interface.longDescription: Collect, inspect, normalize, and prioritize product feedback; manage explainable duplicate links; connect requests to delivery evidence; and track lifecycle activity without replacing the calling agent's judgment.
defaultPrompt: Triage my active FeatureRequest queue and explain your priority decisions.
Find duplicate candidates for this request and compare the evidence.
Pick one ready request, implement it, and link delivery evidence.
